case.evidence_kind: stipulated finite model, not measured physics

facts.text: Two initially aligned panels must retain at least 4 units at ticks 4–7, then separate with all installed retainers removed by boundary 11. No damage/discard/substitution/outside resource.
One operator; one action per integer tick, completes next boundary. Resources cannot occupy two places simultaneously. H initially intact; all other parts free.
detach(H) frees M and S; assemble(H) requires both free. Neither creates retention. H requires M and S to remain assembled for tap.
tap(P1/P2) requires intact H and free pin; each installed pin supplies 2 units. pull removes installed pin. Only pins add capacities; no pins with non-pin retainer.
install(C) supplies 4 retention; remove(C) removes clip.
install(V) then insert(S,V) with detached/free S supplies min(4,4) retention; withdraw(S,V) then remove(V) releases.
place(M) after detach(H), then route(L), supplies min(4,4) retention. unroute(L) then lift(M) releases. Both are needed.
install(Q) supplies theta in {0,4}; theta is initially unmeasured. measure(Q) returns exact theta in one tick, never itself creates retention. remove(Q) releases. No assumed theta.
At most one non-pin retaining assembly installed; it cannot combine with pins. No unlisted operation, adhesive, welding, elastic extrapolation or sustained manual support.
The conventional archive contains two-pin fastening and clip fastening. All supported properties are common to all arms; these known constructions are not locally original.
The discrete-fastener grammar and impact budget b=2 are soft benchmark conventions/preferences, not mechanical laws. b may be set to 2,1,0 only in declared ladder cells.
Available identities: ['H', 'M', 'S', 'P1', 'P2', 'C', 'V', 'L']. Capacity values above are complete; unknowns are not free variables.

case.grammar: Discrete fastening is a mutable benchmark convention; hard requirements are unchanged.

job.instructions: Retrieve only the supplied retained card, then construct on the unfamiliar/current case; flag procedural non-applicability rather than invent properties.

method.instructions: Remove the actual preferred operating dependency, retain the same required function and constraints, and construct a route using only other available resources. Necessity is challenged only by an explicit feasible counterexample; do not silently restore the removed dependency.

applicability: The preferred operating dependency can be identified by the operations that require it, rather than by a label or habitual association.
A permitted operation or constraint can make that dependency unavailable as an operating unit without changing the required function.

Available alternatives and their relevant properties are explicitly supported. Permitted decomposition may expose usable components, but removal of an assembled operating tool is not removal of every component originating from it.
There is enough evidence to build and check an explicit alternative. If the opening is absent or unsupported, report the limitation instead of pretending that removal succeeded.
retrieved_card.burden: Count added removal and release operations, operator commitments, and component occupancy alongside eliminated preferred operations. A component committed to the alternative may prevent rebuilding its original tool. A conventional alternative can satisfy the method while imposing less work, but that does not establish originality. Restoration work belongs in the contract only when required; disclose any remaining altered state.

counterexample.boundary_test: A coupled alternative may have a limiting property below the required threshold despite successful removal and legal setup and release. That counterexample defeats the claim that dependency removal alone guarantees adequacy; it does not defeat every alternative or prove necessity of the original tool.
counterexample.necessity_test: The necessity claim is challenged only by an explicit, validated construction that supplies the unchanged function while the preferred operating dependency remains unavailable. This conclusion is scoped to the checked contract.

retrieved_card.invariant: Write the required function and its acceptance conditions before changing the route. Preserve functional adequacy throughout the required interval, lawful resource use, reversibility or cleanup requirements, and the required end state. Separate hard requirements from soft conventions and preferences; never use a relaxed preference to excuse failure of the function.
mapping_construction_obligation: Provide an explicit mapping from each required property to the resource and mechanism supplying it; include the supported composition rule and every prerequisite.
Provide a complete legal action sequence and resulting resource states. Establishment and release must both satisfy the current contract.
Recalculate adequacy from the current evidence when transferring a procedure. Prior replay success supports investigating that procedure, not copying its outcome into changed conditions.
Trace the removed dependency through the entire route. If a later action reconstitutes and operates it, the dependency-removal condition has been abandoned.
Check all required functional states independently from operation legality. A valid action sequence can still fail the required function.
Distinguish a predicted construction from a received validation result and identify the evidence scope supporting each statement.
operation: Declare the candidate budget and the exact operating dependency to remove.
Apply a licensed removal transition or explicit availability constraint; record the resulting resource state.
Map required functional properties to other available resources or permitted freed components. Change the causal mechanism, not merely the name of the preferred tool.
Construct the complete establishment, maintenance, and release route using only listed operations and supported resource states.
Check the route against every unchanged acceptance condition and report operator work, occupied resources, lost uses, and required restoration separately.

Obtain an explicit replay or applicable validation result before claiming a necessity counterexample. Retain rejection reasons and uncertainty without converting them into a global impossibility claim.
property_extraction: Extract actual availability, initial assembly state, prerequisites, allowed transformations, and resource exclusivity from the current evidence.

Extract each supported functional property and its exact combination rule. Distinguish additive contributions from coupled mechanisms governed by a limiting component; unused strength in another component does not automatically compensate.
Extract the establishment and release requirements, operation completion semantics, operator constraints, forbidden mixtures, and required cleanup sequence.
Mark unknown or unobserved properties explicitly. Do not turn an unavailable item or an unknown property into a free design variable.
Extract conventional constructions and soft preferences separately so that feasibility, preference satisfaction, and originality remain different claims.
refusal: Reject a construction whose supported functional contribution falls below the unchanged requirement, even when all operations are legal and the preferred dependency is absent.

Reject a rescue that lowers the functional requirement, silently restores the removed operating dependency, invents properties, adds an unavailable resource, combines forbidden mechanisms, or omits required release.
If every examined route fails, report the bounded failures. Do not infer necessity of the preferred dependency without a justified exhaustive argument.
Do not count a deliberately forced negative as a spontaneous method failure or use a known construction as evidence of originality.
retrieved_card.state_policy: This external JSON procedure card is the only retained state. Retrieval supplies procedure text for a later application; it does not update model weights. Ordinary active practice retains its ordinary procedure.
retrieved_card.uncertainty: A supplied finite-model replay supports the checked model behavior. It does not establish measured physical performance, universal transfer, comparative method effectiveness, or novelty. Unsupported and unmeasured properties remain unresolved.

attack.failure: specific criticism or honest no supported attack

budget_used.limits: word caps are not equal compute

handoff.residue: inconvenient detail, not supplied to fresh builder unless summary explicitly includes it
handoff.summary: source-bound construction contract with exact operations, constraints, uncertainty/refusal
